تستوضحوا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْضِحُوا (tastawḍiḥū) /tas.taw.dˤi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# تُسْتَوْضَحُوا (tustawḍaḥū) /tus.taw.dˤa.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
